author: Natalie St. Denis
title: Man faces over a dozen felony gun charges in Columbia Co. - NewsBreak
text:
By Natalie St. Denis ,
1 hours ago
CLAVERACK, N.Y. ( NEWS10 ) -- A man is facing several felony weapon charges after authorities executed a search warrant in Columbia County on Wednesday. 36-year-old Adam Kitsock was arrested as a result of the investigation, the Columbia County Sheriff's Office said.
Download our WTEN+ streaming app on Roku, Fire TV and Apple TV! On Wednesday, members of the Sheriff's Office Criminal Investigative Branch, Sheriff's Office Drug Enforcement Unit and members of the Columbia County Sheriff's Office executed the search warrant on County Route 27B in Claverack and a 2022 Doge Ram. The search warrant was related to an ongoing firearms investigation aimed at finding and seizing items related to illegal firearms.
Sheriffs said Kitsock was the subject of the investigation. After making contact with him, the following items were seized as a result of the search warrant:
Five firearm silencers An unfinished AR15 lower receiver An unfinished polymer handgun receiver A fully automatic short barreled rifle A non-compliant AR15-style rifle 9mm assault weapon (ghost gun) Black powder pistol converted to accept center fire cartridges Two .22 caliber rifles Six illegal large capacity ammunition feeding devices Reloading components to include jigs for cutting AR15-style lower receivers and polymer handgun lowers Abundant amount of diverse ammunition (Photo courtesy: Columbia County Sheriff's Office) (Photo courtesy: Columbia County Sheriff's Office) (Photo courtesy: Columbia County Sheriff's Office) (Photo courtesy: Columbia County Sheriff's Office) The Columbia County Sheriff's Office said Kitsock is a convicted felon and is prohibited from possessing any firearms in New York State.
Get the latest news, weather, sports and entertainment delivered right to your inbox! As a result of the investigation and search warrant, Kitsock was arrested and charged with the following:
One count of criminal possession of a weapon in the second degree (five or more firearms) a class C felony Two counts of criminal possession of a weapon in the second degree (loaded firearm) a class C felony One count of criminal possession of a weapon in the third degree (previous conviction) a class D felony Five counts of criminal possession of a weapon in the third degree (firearm silencer) a class D felony One count of criminal possession of a weapon in the third degree (defaced firearm) a class D felony Six counts of criminal possession of a weapon in the third degree (large capacity ammunition feeding device) a class D felony Two counts of criminal possession of a weapon in the fourth degree (convicted felon) a class A misdemeanor Kitsock was arraigned in Town of Claverack Court and held on $50,000 cash bail, $75,000 secured appearance bond or $100,000 partially secured appearance bond. He was ordered to return to the Town of Claverack Court on Friday.
The Columbia County District Attorney's Office assisted in the investigation. Anyone with information regarding criminal activity can contact the sheriff's office tip line at 518-822-8477 or submit tips online anonymously.
